author: Inside Edition
description: Savannah Guthrie and her siblings appealed to their mother's captors in a heart-wrenching video. The full four-minute appeal is being broadcast on every network and cable news outlet. It is believed the siblings recorded the video at Ann Guthrie's house in Tucson, Arizona. The message was carefully scripted and experts Inside Edition spoke to say it was filled with messages both overt and subtle to Nancy Guthrie's captors.
title: Forensic Crime Experts Review Savannah Guthrie's Plea To Mom's Captors

author: Inside Edition
description: Authorities are asking the kidnapper of Savannah Guthrie's mother, Nancy Guthrie, to make contact following the family's appeal seen around the world. TV networks interrupted regular programming to carry a law enforcement press conference live. A new timeline was presented. The local TV news anchor in Tucson who was emailed one of the ransom notes is speaking out, and she says she is convinced it is genuine and not a hoax.
title: Authorities Ask Nancy Guthrie's Kidnapper To Make Contact

author: Inside Edition
description: Critics are calling Margot Robbie and co-star Jacob Elordi's chemistry in the "Wuthering Heights" remake "a whole other level of hot." On a Los Angeles red carpet, Robbie wore a lace bustier gown. In Paris, she donned a red corseted bodice with a dramatic train. Young women are finding the posters at movie theaters and are inserting themselves in Robbie's place.
title: Critics Say Chemistry In 'Wuthering Heights' Remake Is 'Hot'

author: Inside Edition
description: Reporters from across the United States were on hand as Puerto Rican-born singer Bad Bunny opened up about his highly anticipated Super Bowl halftime performance. Many are wondering if Bad Bunny will use the world's largest stage to make a political statement. Since it was announced Bad Bunny was headlining the halftime show, there has been backlash from the Trump administration. Questions have been raised about if the artist was wearing the bulletproof vest at the Grammys.
title: Is Bad Bunny In Fear For His Life?

author: Inside Edition
description: Many citizen sleuths are taking to social media to share their theories about Savannah Guthrie's missing mother, Nancy Guthrie. Sleuths are doing deep dives into the kidnapping from different angles. Some are focusing on the security cameras on Nancy Guthrie's property in Tucson and what they may or may not have captured. Several citizen sleuths are concerned this might be the start of a troubling trend.
title: Citizen Sleuths Share Theories On Nancy Guthrie's Disappearance Online

author: Inside Edition
description: The New England Patriots Cheerleaders and the Seattle Seahawks Dancers gave Inside Edition a warm hello ahead of Sunday's Super Bowl. Inside Edition special correspondent Kylan Darnell, known as the Queen of Bama Rush, got her pom poms and started learning steps from the Seahawks Dancers. The Patriots Cheerleaders taught Inside Edition's Alison Hall their touchdown routine.
title: NFL Cheerleaders Gear Up For Sunday's Super Bowl

author: Inside Edition
description: A traffic stop yielded a lot more than officers were expecting, when they found three children in the trunk of a car that was pulled over for alleged reckless driving. The driver didn't seem surprised when he was pulled over. Then the officer started questioning whether he was drinking. He denied it, then made a stunning admission about the contents of his trunk. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 3 Kids Found In Trunk Of Car Pulled Over On Suspicion Of Reckless Driving

author: Inside Edition
description: Something strange recently happened to reporters from The Associated Press on assignment in Greenland. AP journalist Emma Burrows explains, "We realised that one of our cameras had gone missing." The culprit, it turns out, was a dog. Burrows had little hope of recovering the device, but then, she says, "I saw some dogs running away from the point where we both thought we'd last seen the camera lying on the floor. So I decided to follow them."
title: Dog Steals Reporter's Camera, Hits 'Record'

author: Inside Edition
description: On the day of the big game, Black Hawk choppers will be in the air watching for suspicious activity and a 10-mile no fly zone will be enforced, which includes drones
title: Alison Hall Rides Chopper Over Super Bowl Site #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Troopers were happy to have located this suspect, not that she was in any trouble. Ohio State Police say they received a call that a dog was abandoned on a highway. A patrol car rushed out to the scene and quickly spotted the scared pup. Once they put a leash on the dog, they had to coax her to get off the road. The dog quickly warmed up to the officers, offering kisses and wanting to play. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Troopers Rescue Puppy From Highway

author: Inside Edition
description: President Donald Trump lashed out at CNN journalist Kaitlan Collins as she peppered him with uncomfortable questions about Jeffrey Epstein.
title: Jeffrey Epstein Questions Cause Trump To Lash Out At Reporter #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Volcanologists may soon get a lending paw from a helpful robot called "Anymal." The dog-like machine uses its four legs to walk through uneven terrain – giving it a "leg up" on wheeled vehicles. Anymal is being developed by a team of Swiss researchers, who say this could become an important tool in volcanology. Anymal performed well on recent tests on Sicily's Mt. Etna, needing just a little human help. The hope is that future iterations of Anymal will be fully autonomous.
title: Anymal The Robot Dog Will Venture Close To Volcanoes

author: Inside Edition
description: A woman was trapped in a fully automated car wash. Felicia Sullivan did not know what to do and gave a play-by-play of her ordeal in the car in Waynesboro, Pennsylvania. Sullivan had just left work because she had the stomach flu. She hoped to head right home but she got sick to her stomach and felt obligated to stop at the car wash to clean her car. Getting locked inside the car wash did not help. Sullivan was finally rescued. Her video has been viewed three million times and counting.
title: Woman Gets Trapped Inside Car Wash While Experiencing Stomach Flu

author: Inside Edition
description: TikToker Lisa Pontius is raising awareness about CJD after her husband's passing.
title: Wife Brings Awareness To CJD After Husband’s Death #shorts
